intro: Looking for a hotel near Syracuse, NY? The Cicero Grand sits at I-81 Exit 98 — inside the 15-mile circle that holds everything Syracuse is known for. The JMA Wireless Dome, the Empower FCU Amphitheater, the Oncenter, the State Fairgrounds, NBT Bank Stadium, Syracuse University, Le Moyne, Destiny USA, the Micron build site, and Hancock International Airport are all 6 to 17 minutes from our front door. This is our locals' guide to Syracuse — what to do, where to eat, and what's worth driving for. If a friend was visiting, this is what we'd tell them.
seoBlurb: The Cicero Grand is one of the closest hotels to Micron, Destiny USA, the JMA Wireless Dome, the Empower FCU Amphitheater at Lakeview, the New York State Fairgrounds, and Syracuse Hancock International Airport. Every suite sleeps four with a separate living area, free hot breakfast, indoor heated pool, free parking, and pet-friendly rooms.

faqs.q: What's the closest hotel to Micron in Syracuse?
faqs.a: The Cicero Grand is six minutes from the Micron megafab campus in Clay, NY — making us one of the closest full-service hotels to the build site. We host project crews, vendors, and visiting engineers with extended-stay rates, direct billing, and free truck and trailer parking.

faqs.q: How far is The Cicero Grand from Syracuse Hancock International Airport (SYR)?
faqs.a: Fourteen minutes by car. We're a straight shot south on I-81 from the airport, with no tolls. Park free in our lot during your stay or while you fly.

faqs.q: Is The Cicero Grand close to Destiny USA?
faqs.a: Yes — twelve minutes south on I-81 to Destiny USA, New York's largest shopping center with 250+ stores, restaurants, and entertainment.

faqs.q: How far are we from the JMA Wireless Dome and Syracuse University?
faqs.a: Sixteen minutes to the JMA Wireless Dome and the SU campus. We're a popular choice for SU football, basketball, and lacrosse weekends, parents weekends, recruiting visits, and graduations.

faqs.q: How close is the hotel to the Empower FCU Amphitheater at Lakeview?
faqs.a: Twelve minutes. The Empower Federal Credit Union Amphitheater at Lakeview holds 17,500 fans and hosts the biggest summer concerts in Central New York. We're one of the closest hotels for show nights without paying downtown rates.

faqs.q: How close are we to the New York State Fairgrounds?
faqs.a: Thirteen minutes. The Great New York State Fair (late August through Labor Day) draws nearly a million visitors. The Fairgrounds also host the Syracuse Nationals car show, the Expo Center events, and concerts year-round.

faqs.q: What's the closest hotel to the Oncenter and War Memorial?
faqs.a: Fifteen minutes. The Oncenter complex covers the convention center, Crouse-Hinds Theater, the Upstate Medical University Arena (Syracuse Crunch hockey), and the War Memorial — all in downtown Syracuse off I-81.

faqs.q: Where should I eat near the hotel?
faqs.a: Cracker Barrel is across the street. Twin Trees Cicero (legendary thin-crust pizza), Sal's Birdland (local fried-chicken classic), Cooper-Top Tavern, Hafner's, and Sardo's Pizza are all five minutes away on Route 11 / Route 31. Heid's of Liverpool (white hots since 1917) is eight minutes.

faqs.q: What's the Syracuse food I have to try?
faqs.a: Three things: salt potatoes (boiled in brine, drowned in butter — a CNY original), chicken riggies (Utica‐style pasta with cherry peppers and cream), and a half-moon cookie from Harrison Bakery. Bonus: a white hot from Heid's.

faqs.q: Is the hotel close to Turning Stone Casino?
faqs.a: Thirty-five minutes east on I-90. We're one of the closest non‐Turning Stone hotels for guests attending shows or events. Two more casinos — Yellow Brick Road in Chittenango and Point Place in Bridgeport — are 15–20 minutes away.

transit.title: Getting around
items: Syracuse Hancock International Airport (SYR) — 14 min · direct flights to ATL, DCA, ORD, JFK, BOS, CLT, MCO and more
I-81 Exit 98 — directly off the highway · north to Watertown / 1000 Islands, south to Binghamton & NYC
I-90 NY State Thruway — 8 min · Buffalo (2.5 hr west), Albany (2 hr east)
Amtrak Syracuse Station — 18 min · daily service to NYC, Toronto, Chicago
CENTRO Bus — Syracuse regional transit · stops along Brewerton Rd
Rideshare — Uber & Lyft serve the area; ~$25–35 to downtown
Rental cars — at the airport (Hertz, Enterprise, Avis, National, Budget)
Free hotel parking — including space for trucks, trailers, and project vehicles

neighborhoodsRich.name: Cicero — our village
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: Home base
neighborhoodsRich.description: Our home in northern Onondaga County, sitting between Oneida Lake and the I-81 corridor. Twin Trees pizza, Cracker Barrel across the street, the Cicero Swamp birding preserve, and a five-minute hop to Brewerton Beach.

neighborhoodsRich.name: Liverpool
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: Lakeside village
neighborhoodsRich.description: On the eastern shore of Onondaga Lake — Heid's white hots since 1917, Limp Lizard BBQ, the Salt Museum, and the start of the seven-mile Onondaga Lake Park loop. Ten minutes from the hotel.

neighborhoodsRich.name: Armory Square
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: Downtown nightlife
neighborhoodsRich.description: The lively heart of downtown Syracuse — restored industrial buildings now packed with restaurants, bars, boutiques, and clubs. The Shot Clock Monument and Onondaga Creekwalk run through it.

neighborhoodsRich.name: Skaneateles
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: The Finger Lakes jewel
neighborhoodsRich.description: Twenty-five minutes west. Skaneateles Lake is famously the cleanest in the country, and the village made O Magazine's Charming American Towns list. Boutiques, the Sherwood Inn, Doug's Fish Fry.

neighborhoodsRich.name: Tipperary Hill
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: The Irish neighborhood
neighborhoodsRich.description: Famous for the only "green-on-top" traffic light in America. Coleman's Authentic Irish Pub anchors a tight-knit West Side neighborhood. Best on St. Patrick's Day.

neighborhoodsRich.name: University Hill
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: Syracuse University
neighborhoodsRich.description: SU, SUNY ESF, and SUNY Upstate Medical share this hill. 19th-century architecture, college bars, the JMA Wireless Dome, and a great walk during fall foliage and SU Family Weekend.

neighborhoodsRich.name: Inner Harbor
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: Waterfront revival
neighborhoodsRich.description: An up-and-coming district on the former Barge Canal terminal. Walk the harbor, grab a beer at Meier's Creek Inner Harbor, eat lakefront. Walking distance once you arrive.

neighborhoodsRich.name: Westcott
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: Funky & eclectic
neighborhoodsRich.description: "#WestcottNation" — coffee shops, bakeries, fresh restaurants, and the annual Westcott Street Cultural Fair. Independent and proud of it.

neighborhoodsRich.name: Cazenovia
neighborhoodsRich.subtitle: Lake-village charm
neighborhoodsRich.description: Twenty-five minutes southeast on Cazenovia Lake. The Brewster Inn and Brae Loch Inn for fine dining, Owera Vineyards and Meier's Creek for tastings, Critz Farms for u-pick fruit.

dayTrips.name: Skaneateles Lake
dayTrips.description: The "Jewel of the Finger Lakes." Stroll the village, lunch at Doug's Fish Fry, wine and views at Anyela's Vineyards. A perfect weekend turn.

dayTrips.name: Green Lakes State Park
dayTrips.description: Two glacial lakes with otherworldly turquoise color, plus hiking trails, a swimming beach, and a championship golf course.

dayTrips.name: Cazenovia
dayTrips.description: Lakeside village dining at the Brewster Inn, wine at Owera Vineyards, beer at Meier's Creek, u-pick fruit and a kids' area at Critz Farms.

dayTrips.name: Beak & Skiff Apple Orchards
dayTrips.description: U-pick apples, wagon rides, hot apple fritters, donuts, and the 1911 Tasting Room for hard cider and spirits. Best in fall.

dayTrips.name: Tinker Falls & Labrador Hollow
dayTrips.description: A peaceful hike to a tiered waterfall and a unique boardwalk through wetlands. Spring through fall, easy difficulty.

dayTrips.name: Pratt's Falls State Park
dayTrips.description: 137-foot glacier-formed waterfall plus the site of Onondaga County's first mill (1796). Trails, picnic spots, and an archery range.

dayTrips.name: Beaver Lake Nature Center
dayTrips.description: Family-friendly trails, guided nature programs, and a great kids' option for a half-day outdoors.

dayTrips.name: Finger Lakes wine country
dayTrips.description: Cayuga and Seneca Lake wine trails are an easy drive. Make it a long lunch or a full day; the Riesling country is world-class.

seasonal.name: St. Patrick's Day & opening day
seasonal.description: Tipperary Hill goes all-in for St. Paddy's. Syracuse Mets opening day at NBT Bank Stadium. Onondaga Lake Park reopens to full activity. Cherry blossoms at Onondaga Park.

seasonal.name: Lake season & amphitheater concerts
seasonal.description: Onondaga Lake Park trails, Skaneateles boating, Mets baseball, and the Empower FCU Amphitheater concert run. Westcott Street Cultural Fair late summer.

seasonal.name: The Great New York State Fair
seasonal.description: 13 days starting late August at the State Fairgrounds, ending Labor Day. The largest agricultural fair in the Northeast. Plan parking in advance.

seasonal.name: Foliage & apple season
seasonal.description: Syracuse fall is exceptional. Beak & Skiff for apple picking, Lafayette Apple Festival in October, drives through the Route 20 Scenic Byway. SU football season is here too.

seasonal.name: Snow, ski, & SU basketball
seasonal.description: Labrador Mountain and Song Mountain for skiing, Highland Forest for cross-country. SU basketball is in season at the Dome. Lights on the Lake at Onondaga Lake Park.

seasonal.name: The Dome, year-round
seasonal.description: JMA Wireless Dome (the "Loud House") draws Springsteen and Billy Joel as readily as it draws SU games. Always check the calendar — there's usually something on.
